title: BoJ Watch - Impressions from Deputy Governor Himino’s Speech

classification.rationale: The note interprets Deputy Governor Himino's speech as BoJ communication/guidance, judging its hawkish tone and signal for the September meeting and the pace of rate hikes.
classification.runner_up_reason: The speech is read for implications on timing and pace of hikes, but the main focus is the communication itself rather than a rate path forecast.
